_meta.purpose: Machine-readable map of this repo's structure and purpose, so any future turn/session/agent can orient without re-exploring the whole tree.
_meta.conventions: Append-only per user instruction: 'paths' reflects current state and may be corrected in place, but every structural change must also add an entry to 'history' so nothing is silently lost. Never delete a 'history' entry.

memory.name: Mem0
memory.reason: Purpose-built AI memory layer (add_memory/search_memories/entities), tested reachable this turn via add_memory.

additional.name: Context7
additional.reason: Current library/framework/spec documentation lookup, directly serves CLAUDE.md's standards-compliance mandate. Selected, not yet invoked (no concrete need arose).

additional.name: Mermaid Chart
additional.reason: Lightweight code-as-diagram rendering, fits a git-tracked static site better than an external whiteboard tool. Reserved for future use; not invoked (would be scope creep without a concrete need).

CLAUDE.md.purpose: Internal authoring constitution. Governs writing style (Rule Zero: plain words first, anti-slop) and engineering standards (WHATWG/W3C/MDN compliance, YAGNI/KISS/DRY, verify-before-done) for everything in this repo. Never referenced from published pages.

README.md.purpose: Public repo overview: what this is, how to use the site/skills/prompts exports.

CONTRIBUTING.md.purpose: How to add a principle page, skill, or prompt; points to scripts/verify-site.py as the pre-commit gate.

todo.md.purpose: Locked v1 deliverables checklist and completion checkpoint. Append-only.

changelog.md.purpose: Turn-by-turn history with the non-negotiable turncount. Append-only.

.yamllint.yml.purpose: Was: disables yamllint's truthy/line-length rules for Super-Linter's yamllint. REMOVED at turncount 2 along with Super-Linter (user instruction) -- had no other consumer.

.markdownlint.yml.purpose: Was: attempted to disable MD013 for Super-Linter's markdownlint; confirmed NOT honored (its bundled default of 400 won instead). REMOVED at turncount 2 along with Super-Linter (user instruction) -- had no other consumer.

.stylelintrc.json.purpose: Was: extends stylelint-config-standard, disabling 4 cosmetic rules for Super-Linter's stylelint. REMOVED at turncount 2 along with Super-Linter (user instruction) -- had no other consumer.

docs/.purpose: GitHub Pages site source (the Pages 'source' folder). Plain HTML/CSS, no build step, no JS.

index.html.purpose: Home page: card grid linking every principle page, in pedagogical order.

about.html.purpose: How to read the site and use the /skills and /prompts exports.

assets/style.css.purpose: Whole site's CSS: design tokens, responsive nav, good/bad example blocks, checklist styling, light/dark mode.

.nojekyll.purpose: Skips GitHub's default Jekyll processing since the site is plain static HTML.

principles/*.html (10 files).purpose: One canonical page per concept, each following CLAUDE.md's 6-part skeleton (definition, why it matters, core rule, good/bad example, common mistakes, checklist).

skills/.purpose: Claude Code skills (SKILL.md format) turning principle checklists into agent-runnable procedures.

design-critique/SKILL.md.purpose: Reviews UI/HTML against all 10 principles' checklists; links back to every canonical page.

accessibility-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Line-by-line code-scanning a11y audit with severity tiers; links back to the accessibility page.

plain-language-rewrite/SKILL.md.purpose: Operationalizes Rule Zero itself for arbitrary text; no single canonical page (it's the site's whole ethos, not one principle).

prompts/.purpose: Standalone system prompts (personas + judgment), for use outside Claude Code with any LLM.

web-design-mentor.md.purpose: Teaching persona for conversational design guidance.

design-critique-reviewer.md.purpose: Structured-feedback persona for reviewing UI, mirrors skills/design-critique's checklist.

scripts/verify-site.py.purpose: Stdlib-only checker: HTML tag balance, internal link resolution, CLAUDE.md skeleton-section presence, CSS brace balance. The repo's substitute for a test suite; also run in CI.

scripts/requirements.txt.purpose: Pins html5validator==0.4.2 (the only external Python dependency, used in CI for real W3C HTML validation). Exists specifically so actions/setup-python's pip cache has a lockfile to key off.

.github/workflows/pages.yml.purpose: Builds docs/ and deploys to GitHub Pages on every push to main touching docs/**. Independent of ci.yml so a flaky external link can never block a deploy.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.purpose: Two parallel jobs: verify-site (scripts/verify-site.py + W3C html5validator), link-check (lychee, external links only). Previously had a third super-linter job, removed at turncount 2 (see history) after 3 rounds of real failures -- verify-site + real html5validator/stylelint runs already covered correctness.

.github/dependabot.yml.purpose: Weekly PRs to keep every pinned GitHub Action version/SHA current.

history.change: Initial codemap created capturing full repo state as of this turn (repo already contained the site, skills, prompts, and CI/CD from prior turns; this is the first turn codemap.json itself has existed).

Removed Super-Linter job from .github/workflows/ci.yml (explicit user instruction, after 3 rounds of real failures). Removed .stylelintrc.json, .markdownlint.yml, .yamllint.yml as a consequence -- they existed solely to configure Super-Linter's bundled tools and had no other consumer once it was gone.
